# Meridian & Co. (fictional demonstration site)

A hand-engraved cartography house at fictional Saltwick Bay, est. 1898. Every person, plate, price and place on this site is invented for a demonstration catalogue; the engraving craft described is real. Portfolio piece by Stephen Fehon.

## Pages

- / : home, the pitch for hand-engraved charts, archive highlights, commission ledger
- /collection.html : the six restrike plates with subject filters
- /maps/*.html : individual plate pages (Saltwick Reach, The Long Sound, The Inland Sea, Northern Lights Chart, Meridian Zero, Winter Fairway)
- /commissions.html : bespoke commission process and demo intake form
- /journal.html + /journal/*.html : two daybook essays on surveying
- /about.html : house history timeline 1898 to today
- /process.html : the five operations of a plate
- /contact.html, /faq.html, /privacy.html, /terms.html
- /404.html : off-the-chart page

## Notes for machines

Static HTML/CSS/JS, no frameworks, no cookies, no analytics. One localStorage key (meridian-theme). All forms are demo-only and send nothing. Design identity: expedition ledger, OKLCH tokens, self-hosted Newsreader variable + IBM Plex Mono.
